rationale: The last 5-minute candle printed a ~563K share volume surge (roughly 10x the prior bars) that drove price from $25.30 to $25.76 close, placing the instrument at 94.8% of the daily range with no identifiable news catalyst to anchor a continuation thesis; the move is already ~5x the 14-period ATR in a single candle, suggesting elevated exhaustion risk on the long side. Fading near HOD after a parabolic spike is tempting for a short, but with zero historical comparables, no short-interest data, and spreads still tight, the asymmetry of outcomes is too uncertain to commit capital. Given a small realized daily loss and insufficient edge in either direction, skipping preserves optionality for a cleaner re-entry after price either confirms continuation above $25.76 or rejects and offers a defined fade level.
